original_excerpt: Drawing on TAM and UTAUT, this study relates AI use to perceived AI usefulness, perceived AI risks, and four contextual constructs: AI-related training, teachers’ stress, institutional support, and school innovation climate. … This model was tested with TALIS 2024 data from 1766 lower secondary teachers in the United Arab Emirates and Shanghai, China. … Structural equation modeling and multi-group SEM showed that training (β = 0.401, p < 0.001) and perceived AI usefulness (β = 0.250, p < 0.001) were the strongest direct constructs associated with AI use.
